name: browser-context-diagnostics
goal: Capture each console error and uncaught exception before and after popup page availability, without duplicate diagnostics or browser startup for API tests

evidence: CI job 117504616589 and the unchanged two-worker local E2E both reported popup navigation error as expected success at 6abda8f8. The collector from 776e98aa attaches only after context page availability, after an initial script may run.

Existing generated-browser coverage includes popup navigation but macOS timing had hidden its failure. Missing deterministic lifecycle inputs: context console/weberror before page announcement and overlapping context/page delivery. Strengthen existing browser-console unit/E2E and host-capture coverage; retain template parity and API-only lazy startup checks.

At unchanged product 6abda8f8, bun x vitest run test/browser-console-errors.test.ts test/host-capture-errors.test.ts failed both early lifecycle cases: expected initial document failed plus later script failed; received only later script failed. Real generated-popup E2E also fails in CI and the full local two-worker run.

Observe BrowserContext console and weberror before navigation, using each event page for provenance; remove page observers to avoid duplicate delivery. Keep generated fixture parity and lazy setup. Strengthen the existing browser-fixture acceptance rule with deterministic pre-page and overlapping-event lifecycle coverage in normal unit verification.

Shared and generated fixtures now subscribe to BrowserContext console/weberror directly; no per-page observer can attach too late or double-count. Existing unit, real generated popup/exception, expected-error and API-only cases cover the lifecycle. The existing shared-fixture acceptance rule now requires pre-page and overlapping-event coverage.

Same unchanged lifecycle assertions passed after repair. bun x vitest run test/browser-console-errors.test.ts test/host-capture-errors.test.ts test/browser-console-errors.e2e.test.ts test/browser-console-expected.e2e.test.ts --maxWorkers 2 passed all 10 tests, including popup console/exception, exact expected diagnostics and API-only unavailable-browser behavior.

Copied the frozen lifecycle test into an isolated temporary workspace. Restoring only the collector from 6abda8f8 caused both pre-page assertions to fail on missing initial document failed; replacing only that fixture with the repair passed both tests. Guard logs retained under ignored .cache/browser-error-evidence. The initial Bun-hosted harness bootstrap error was excluded; proof used the normal Node Vitest runner.
